title: Jump loci of fibre cohomology of a perfect complex
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $E$ be a pseudo-coherent complex [def-pc-derived-category] (in particular, a perfect complex [def-pc-perfect-complex]). For each integer $i$ define $\beta_i(x)=\dim_{\kappa(x)}H^i(Li_x^*E)$ for $x\in X$. Then formation of $\beta_i$ commutes with arbitrary base change, each $\beta_i$ is upper semicontinuous, and every level set of $\beta_i$ is locally constructible.
